publicationDecision.authorisation: Matt's standing Medicines Watch instruction authorises needed evidence-backed informational additions and corrections to go live without repeat permission.
publicationDecision.scope: Add six newly posted semaglutide specialist-use records to the existing summary and one separate observational GLP-1/sarcopenia study. Editorial authorisation is not clinical approval.

reviewType: AI-assisted primary-source factual review; not clinical approval

fields.stage: Nine Phase 2/4 specialist-use studies registered; all not yet recruiting
fields.summaryToAppend: Six records first posted on 5 October add five Phase 4 metabolic-and-bariatric-surgery studies from one Egyptian unit and the Canadian PIVOT Phase 4 study in advanced kidney disease. The surgical records separately study pre-operative use at BMI 60 kg/m² or higher, recurrent weight gain, semaglutide around conversion surgery, tapering versus abrupt discontinuation, and immediate versus criterion-triggered treatment. PIVOT compares semaglutide plus virtual coaching with usual care while studying weight and kidney-transplant access.
fields.limitationsToAppend: All six new records remain not yet recruiting and have no posted results. The five Egyptian records list estimated October 2026 starts without establishing that recruitment or dosing began; their protocols, tapering schedule and comparator strategies are research designs, not clinical instructions or evidence of benefit. PIVOT lists an estimated January 2027 start, 880 estimated participants and Canadian sites; neither its title nor planned outcomes establish improved transplant access. These indication-specific records do not extend Wegovy's UK authorisation, NICE/NHS access or actual supply.

entries.name: GLP-1 use and sarcopenia observation
entries.stage: Recruiting observational study; no treatment assigned; no posted results
entries.summary: NCT07858864 observes 42 estimated adults in Turkey who start a GLP-1 or dual GLP-1/GIP medicine prescribed as routine obesity care. Over three months it records SARC-F screening, hand-grip strength, chair-stand and gait performance, bioelectrical-impedance body composition and routine laboratory results.
entries.ukAuthorisation: This observational record does not establish a new UK medicine authorisation or a muscle-preservation indication for semaglutide, tirzepatide or a drug class.
entries.nhsEngland: The Turkish observational study does not establish a NICE recommendation or NHS England access pathway.
entries.supply: The study does not assign, supply or alter treatment. Routine prescribing in Turkey does not establish UK pharmacy stock, lawful UK supply or sale by Shift Some Timber.
entries.limitations: The record was first posted on 5 October 2026 after an actual 30 May study start and remains recruiting, with estimated November completion. It has no untreated comparator, allows different medicines, doses and durations chosen by treating physicians, estimates only 42 participants and posts no results. Planned sarcopenia, strength, function and body-composition measurements do not establish muscle loss, muscle preservation, causation, class effects, clinical benefit or a treatment recommendation.

configuredSourcePass.boundary: The SELECT-only response verifies configured-source monitoring only. It does not renew factual reviews, approve changed wording or prove complete industry coverage. The two known HTTP 403 checks remain explicit.

discoveryPass.method: A separate 5 October ClinicalTrials.gov first-posted search covered obesity, overweight, weight loss, GLP-1, peptides, sarcopenia, lean mass and body composition. Primary regulator/NHS and sponsor-domain searches covered the named developer set plus broader primary sources; exact candidate API bodies were read before inclusion.
discoveryPass.existingWork: The merged expansion through PR #1127 and the absence of later open review PRs were checked before publication. TE-8105, the 2 October semaglutide specialist summary and existing muscle-preservation programmes were not duplicated.

exclusions.reason: Completed intuitive-eating intervention after bariatric surgery; no medicine or peptide intervention.
Exercise and dietary-guidance study in older adults with excess adiposity; no medicine or peptide intervention.
Phase 3 ALN-CIDEB MASLD study without a weight-management treatment aim; retained as adjacent-indication follow-up.

discoveryPass.limitations: Search indexing was uneven and one broad API query returned an HTTP 400 before a valid date-bounded query succeeded. Selected domains and registry terms cannot establish exhaustive industry coverage. No new primary sponsor or UK regulator/NHS announcement requiring a catalogue correction was found in this pass.
